message:
Both tests now pass.

The failure was in `src/vat.js`: `withVat` used `Math.floor(pence * 1.2)`, so `withVat(999)` returned 1198 instead of 1199. I changed it to `Math.round`, which matches the "nearest penny" comment. `npm test` now reports 2 passing, 0 failing.

I didn't commit the change. The working tree has the one-line edit in `src/vat.js`.
